CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cleanarr is a web app for getting disk back from a Radarr and Sonarr library. It shows what you have, who watched it, and who requested it, then lets you delete what nobody is watching. It works on a desktop browser and on a phone.
This repository, including the Unraid templates, metadata, and docs, is MIT licensed. Support and source: https://github.com/michaelmurfy/cleanarr/issues
